filters.description: Saved ticket filter criteria: status, priority, channel, sla, aiTriageResult, assignee, tags, tagsMatch, tagsExclude, dateFrom, dateTo, sorting, and search.

aiTriageResult.description: AI triage outcomes to include. 'in_progress' matches tickets still being triaged.

items.description:
* `persisted` - persisted
* `escalated_with_best` - escalated_with_best
* `escalated_no_reply` - escalated_no_reply
* `skipped_unactionable` - skipped_unactionable
* `blocked_unsafe` - blocked_unsafe
* `blocked_unsafe_reply` - blocked_unsafe_reply
* `in_progress` - in_progress

assignee.description: Assignees to match (any of): 'unassigned', 'me' (resolved to the requesting user), or an object with type ('user' or 'role') and id. Send a list. Views saved earlier can hold a single value instead of a list, or the value 'all'. Wrap a single value in a list, and replace 'all' with an empty list to apply no assignee filter.

channel.description:
Channel the ticket originated from. 'all' disables the filter.

* `widget` - widget
* `email` - email
* `slack` - slack
* `teams` - teams
* `github` - github
* `all` - all

dateFrom.description: Only include tickets updated on or after this date. Accepts absolute dates (2026-01-01) or relative ones (-7d). 'all' or null disables the bound.

dateTo.description: Only include tickets updated on or before this date. Same format as dateFrom.

priority.description: Ticket priorities to include. Empty or omitted means all priorities.

search.description: Free-text search. A numeric value matches a ticket number exactly; otherwise matches the customer's name or email, the email subject, or message content.

sla.description:
SLA state: 'breached' is past due, 'at-risk' is due within the next hour, 'on-track' has more than an hour remaining. 'all' disables the filter.

* `breached` - breached
* `at-risk` - at-risk
* `on-track` - on-track
* `all` - all

columnKey.description: Ticket column to sort by (updated_at, sla_due_at, snoozed_until, created_at, ticket_number). Unknown columns fall back to updated_at.

sorting.description: Sort order for the ticket list.

status.description: Ticket statuses to include. Empty or omitted means all statuses.

items.description:
* `new` - New
* `open` - Open
* `pending` - Pending
* `on_hold` - On hold
* `resolved` - Resolved

tags.description: Tag names to match, combined according to tagsMatch.

tagsExclude.description: Tickets carrying any of these tags are excluded.

tagsMatch.description:
'any' returns tickets with at least one of tags (OR); 'all' requires every tag (AND).

* `any` - any
* `all` - all

is_favorited.description: Whether the current user has favorited this view. Favorited views sort to the top of the list. Favorites are personal to each user.

name.description: Display name of the view, as it appears in the ticket views list.
